Jasper is the leading AI marketing platform, enabling the world's most innovative companies to reimagine their end-to-end marketing workflows and drive higher ROI through increased brand consistency, efficiency, and personalization at scale.
Jasper has been recognized as "one of the Top 15 Most Innovative AI Companies of 2024" by Fast Company and is trusted by nearly 20% of the Fortune 500 – including Prudential, Ulta Beauty, and Wayfair. Founded in 2021, Jasper is a remote-first organization with team members across the US, France, and Australia.

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO , you will be a trusted strategic partner and force multiplier for our CEO, helping him operate at his highest level of impact. This role demands exceptional organizational skills, strong communication abilities, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.

Alongside this strategic remit, you'll also manage the CEO's schedule, travel, meeting materials, and other administrative essentials — with the same precision and attention to detail.

This role demands exceptional judgment, strong communication abilities across all levels of the organization, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.
This role reports to the Senior Manager, Executive Operations, and works in close daily partnership with the CEO. The role is open to candidates located in the UK, with a strong preference for someone based in London. While this is a fully remote role, there may be times when meeting the CEO and various partners in our London office is necessary, so flexibility to work out of this office is required.

s.h: What You Will Do At Jasper
s.t:
Manage the CEO’s schedule to arrange meetings, triage incoming requests, and ensure that all deadlines are met effectively.
Coordinate and facilitate communication between the executive and other internal team members, ensuring clear and effective collaboration.
Support the Executive Team working cadence including weekly meetings, regular brainstorming sessions and quarterly offsites.
Own travel arrangements and external engagement logistics with meticulous attention to detail, building contingency plans so nothing is left to chance.
Assist with key priorities including preparing necessary materials and organizing the CEO’s workflow.
Proactively identify issues and implement solutions to maintain momentum on critical activities.
Prepare materials and organize workflow to keep the CEO's key priorities moving forward.
Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Executive Operations and cross-functional leaders to strengthen and continuously improve executive operations processes.
Support the CEO's engagement with the Board and other senior stakeholders, including helping prepare materials and coordinate logistics for Board meetings and other high-stakes, elevated communications.
What You Will Bring To Jasper
7+ years of experience as an executive assistant or in a similar administrative role, ideally supporting C-level executives — with 2-4+ years directly supporting a CEO or Founder strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort communicating at the Board and executive level.
Sound independent judgment and decision-making — able to distinguish between what to run with and what to escalate.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and autonomously.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and external contacts.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

The expected base salary range offered for this role is £85,000 - £100,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Administrative Support

Assist with project coordination and task tracking

Research and book travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation)

Coordinate virtual and in-person meetings or events
Operations & Task Management
Support day-to-day business operations

Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency

Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently in a remote environment

This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is based on a percentage of client monthly plans, with average monthly earnings ranging from $1,500-$3,800, depending on client mix.
Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:
No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates
No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment

Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support Figma’s Chief People Officer and VP, Talent to strategically manage the day-to-day administrative and operational needs of the People organization, while also contributing significantly to projects and initiatives that help drive the company’s priorities.

You’ll be responsible for keeping the leaders and teams organized, aligned, and helping them maintain focus while scaling for growth and delivering an exceptional internal and external experience.

This role will strategically manage day-to-day administrative and operational needs, infuse Figma’s culture and values in the work to create a meaningful Figmate experience, and cross-functionally collaborate with the broader People Org and stakeholders across Figma.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant who has supported at a VP or C-Suite level before. Experience with People or Talent Teams is a bonus.

This is a full-time role based out of our SF Hub.

· Support the Chief People Officer and VP, Talent with calendar, travel, meetings, agendas, preparation, tasks, notes, emails.

· Serve as a strategic thought and execution partner to your Executives and their leadership teams, with a focus on team cohesion, operations, and planning.

· Identify areas to optimize the Executives’ time and make recommendations regarding time management, prioritization, and business needs.

· Partner with internal teams to ensure cross functional alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events – this will include some ad hoc project management

· Act as a delegate for your Executives by signing off on expenses, approving POs, and managing other tooling as needed, with careful attention to internal policy.

· Find opportunities for process optimization across team and company workflows.

· Prepare and/or build content, presentations, and key documents for your leaders

· Partner cross-functionally with the People Team and other internal teams to ensure alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events.

s.h: We’d love to hear from you if you have
s.t:
· 7+ years of experience in a senior administrative support role.

· Experience working in a fast-paced environment with the ability to adapt quickly to changing demands.

· Outstanding communication skills and the ability to connect with a broad spectrum of stakeholders internally and externally, both in person and online.

· The ability to shift gears and prioritize based on the volume and urgency of requests.

· Expertise in prioritizing, connecting dots, and anticipating needs.

· A commitment to being trustworthy, reliable, and maintaining the strictest confidentiality.

· Dedication to fostering inclusivity and navigating initiatives through an optimistic lens.

s.h: While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have
s.t:
· Experience with our product suite.

· Supported teams of 100+ people (bonus points for complex global teams).

· Previous experience supporting People or Recruiting teams.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.
This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.
You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.
Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience
Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.
Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.
Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.
Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.
Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.
Coordinate Office Operations
Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.
Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.
Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.
Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.
Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.
Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.
Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.
Support office utilization reporting.
Leadership & Administrative Support
Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.
Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.
Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.
Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.
This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.
Support Gatherings & Connection
Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.
Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.
Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.
Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.
Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.
Build Strong Relationships
Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.
Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.
Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
Full professional proficiency in English and German.
This position needs to be based in the Berlin office 5 days a week.

s.h: How We'll Take Care of You
s.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.

This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.

This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.

This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.

You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.

Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience

· Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.

· Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.

· Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.

· Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.

· Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.

Coordinate Office Operations

· Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.

· Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.

· Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.

· Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.

· Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.

· Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.

· Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.

· Support office utilization reporting.

Leadership & Administrative Support

· Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.

· Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.

· Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.

· Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.

This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.

Support Gatherings & Connection

· Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.

· Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.

· Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.

· Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.

· Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.

Build Strong Relationships

· Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

· Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.

· Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.

· Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

· 5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.

· Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

· Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

· Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.

· Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

· Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.

· Full professional proficiency in English.
This position needs to be based in the London office 5 days a week.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Databricks is looking for a highly capable, process-driven, and proactive Executive Assistant to support a Senior Leader within Product & Engineering, while also supporting our SVP of Corporate Development & Ventures.

The primary mission of this person is to support our Engineering and Product leaders, partnering with them to operationalize their teams' cross-functional strategies. You will serve as a key liaison across various departments—including Sales, Marketing, IT, and other critical functions—to ensure alignment and execution. Additionally, you will drive strategic initiatives and community events that foster collaboration across the Engineering and Product organizations.

While deeply rooted in supporting a massive internal engineering footprint, this high-visibility, fast-paced role sits at a unique intersection. · Provide timely responses to all stakeholder requests.

· Enhance the Engineering leader's time efficiency, leading to a more productive team and company.

· Confidentiality & Discretion: Handles sensitive, non-public information—including product roadmaps, M&A targets, term sheets, and board-level matters—with the judgment and professionalism appropriate to that trust.

· Team Coverage: May be required to support other executive staff members if there's a coverage gap due to PTO, sickness, maternity leave, or other absences.

· Minimum of 7+ years of applicable executive administrative experience, ideally from a global software organization.

· Proven track record working with VPs/SVPs in Engineering and Product in large organizations.

· Experience working with VPs managing over 2000+ people in engineering, customer-facing, and/or technical roles.

· Ability to work at a fast pace with shifting priorities in a hyper-scaling, high-growth company, with experience directly supporting an executive staff member.

· High attention to detail , organization, and process abilities; structured thinking with an operational mindset that can bring order to chaos.

· Strong calendaring skills (Gmail and Google Calendar experience mandatory).

· Strong relationship management skills and the ability to build a personal network throughout the company; you earn trust quickly and know how to work through organizational complexity.

· Strong teamwork skills , and a confident ability to offer suggestions and improvements to the process, and work very collaboratively with others.

· Strong oral and written communication with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders, developers, and external partners.

· Technology Fluency: A genuine curiosity about technology, high-growth companies, and the AI/data landscape. Comfortable dealing with engineers, technical leaders, and opinionated entrepreneurs.

Why This Role

You'll work alongside the core engine of Databricks and one of the most active corporate development teams in enterprise tech. Duties and Responsibilities: Serves as the subject matter expert (SME) with independent responsibility for all accounting aspects of the Buckley MWR, Lodging, and assigned GSU MWR Funds, ensuring the overall integrity, accuracy, and propriety of the NAF accounting system, including all financial records, reports, and statements.

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.
Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform that provides a secure infrastructure for the movement, storage, and issuance of digital assets.

The platform has gained popularity among major trading desks due to its alignment with the preferences of both CISOs and Ops Teams.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.
About the Workplace & Real Estate Team
The Workplace & Real Estate team builds the places where LangChain builds the future of AI agents. We want every office to be somewhere people enjoy showing up to, spaces that run smoothly and feel good to be in. We think of the workplace as something worth designing thoughtfully and improving over time.

We're a small, high-agency team with an on-site point person in each hub, and we try to automate the manual work rather than just adding more of it, across our SF and NY hubs plus co-working spokes as we grow.

The Office Manager helps run our SF HQ day to day, both the on-the-ground experience and the systems that support it. SF is our largest hub and headquarters, we're moved into a new space, and we regularly host meet-ups, company and team onsites.

You'll open and reset the space each morning and be a friendly, steady presence through the day and over time you'll contribute to the tooling, standards, and vendor relationships that keep things running well as we scale. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking care of a space and building the systems behind it.
Location: This role is based on-site in our San Francisco (HQ) office, five days a week.

Take care of the space
Open and reset the space each morning so it's clean, stocked, and welcoming before people arrive
Keep the space organized, tidy, and well-stocked, a space the team can feel good about
Do a regular walkthrough to catch small things before they become bigger ones
Be a friendly presence in the office
Be a visible, welcoming presence during business hours, greet guests, help new hires and visitors get oriented, and be someone people can turn to
Help plan and run local in-office events, team moments, and offsites hosted at HQ
Support operations, vendors & budget
Coordinate facilities, supplies, snacks, and equipment; build relationships with on-site vendors (cleaning, food, maintenance); serve as a point of contact for building management and repairs
Keep vendor programs consistent
Support budget tracking for the office; track cost-per-seat and utilization alongside Finance
Contribute to systems & standards
Manage the workplace ticket queue in Console and contribute to a shared SLA framework
Partner with IT to roll out and maintain the workplace tech stack - desk booking, room scheduling, visitor management, mailroom/deliveries
Build and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and trackers; contribute to shared standards across sites
Support space planning and moves for the office
Take part in running life-safety practices (emergency action plan, evacuation, first aid/AED, drills) as part of the company-wide program
Look for ways to make repetitive work - tickets, vendor comms, inventory, invoice/billing reconciliation

Hard Skills
2–4 years in office/workplace management, facilities, or workplace operations, ideally in a fast-growing company
Organized and comfortable keeping plans, budgets, and status visible and up to date
Experience with workplace systems (ticketing, desk/room booking, visitor management) or vendor programs
Soft Skills
Hospitality mindset - you enjoy making colleagues and guests feel welcome (a hotel or hospitality background is a plus, not a requirement)
Ownership - you like taking care of things without being asked, and enjoy improving the systems around you
Attention to detail - you take pride in a clean, well-run space
Reliability - comfortable with a consistent, on-site, 5-day presence
Run to the roar - steady and proactive, you move toward problems instead of away from them when something breaks

Hospitality background (hotels, premium service)
Experience supporting office moves or buildouts
Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or similar tools
Comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently

¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un auto privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?
Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer ‘unicornio’ español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid pero actualmente nos encontramos en 42 ciudades de España y Latinoamérica.

Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’.

Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien.

Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma.

Además, siempre cumplimos plenamente con las regulaciones gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales. Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!

Este rol combina la gestión operativa con una visión estratégica del espacio de trabajo, liderando tanto los aspectos funcionales como el diseño y bienestar del entorno físico.

Gestión Operativa
Garantizar el correcto funcionamiento de nuestras oficinas en el día a día.

Joining Collibra’s Office of the CEO team
Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer. In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the day-to-day logistics that keep our CEO operating efficiently, from complex calendar management and global travel to meeting coordination and administrative support.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy. You'll anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and use your judgment to make decisions on behalf of the CEO when needed, knowing what requires his attention and what you can confidently handle independently.
You'll work closely with leaders and partner with colleagues across the business to make the best use of his time, enabling him to stay focused on leading the company. While your primary responsibility will be supporting the CEO, you'll also provide support to other senior leaders as business needs require. You'll operate as part of the Management Office, partnering daily with the NYC-based Operations & Events Lead.
While you own the day-to-day logistics of scheduling execution, executive briefings, client meeting tracking, travel, expenses, and Brussels-based coordination, the central team owns strategic calendar oversight and ExCom operations. This partnership ensures seamless coverage across time zones and that our leadership has coverage across our two main offices: Brussels and New York.
This is a hybrid role based in our Brussels office. Our hybrid model means you'll work from the office at least four days each week. This role also requires some evening overlap with US East Coast working hours along with occasional early morning meetings across EMEA time zones.
Executive Assistants at Collibra are responsible for
Providing comprehensive administrative support to the CEO with the highest level of discretion, anticipating needs before they arise and ensuring every meeting is confirmed, prepped, and logistically sound.
Monitoring incoming communications and requests for the CEO's time, proactively resolving conflicts and exercising sound judgment to balance competing priorities and keep the CEO focused on what matters most.
Coordinating all aspects of domestic and international travel including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries, while managing procurement, vendor, and expense approval workflows via Zip and Navan and reconciling the CEO's expenses, ensuring nothing bottlenecks.
Supporting the planning and execution of leadership meetings, offsites, and executive events in close partnership with the NYC-based CEO Operations and Events Lead, staying several steps ahead to ensure seamless coverage across Brussels and New York.
Acting as the connective tissue across the business by building strong relationships, facilitating communication, coordinating legal document execution, and gathering EMEA-side context to support client visit briefs.
Welcoming visitors and coordinating executive meetings in the Brussels office, while providing administrative support to other senior leaders and handling occasional personal requests with professionalism and care.
You have
8–10 years of experience supporting senior executives, including experience supporting a C-suite executive.
Extensive experience managing complex calendars, international travel, and executive scheduling across multiple time zones.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and stay several steps ahead.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and a warm, professional, customer-focused approach.
Excellent judgment and the ability to handle highly confidential information with complete discretion, including regular exposure to Board-level materials and sensitive company information..
Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Experience with modern executive operations tooling; Navan, Zip (or comparable travel and procurement platforms), DocuSign, Slack, and Zoom.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes.
Experience working in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.
A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
You are
Highly organized, proactive, and dependable.
Calm under pressure and able to manage multiple competing priorities with confidence.
An exceptional planner who enjoys creating order and solving logistical challenges.
Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Able to anticipate needs and adapt quickly as priorities change.
Comfortable working independently while building strong relationships across the organization.
Willing to roll up your sleeves—no task is too small.
Trusted to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and sound judgment.

About Proton

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.

Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.

Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

· Document and distribute meeting minutes and action items

· Greet guests and assist with special projects relating to guest/visitors

· Other duties as assigned

We're looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Head of Marketing at Amplitude. This is a highly visible role that goes beyond traditional executive support—you'll help protect executive time, turn ideas into action, and ensure important work keeps moving across the marketing organization and broader company.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional operational strength and judgment with a high-agency mindset and strong AI fluency, using technology to make our leaders and teams more connected, efficient, and effective.
This role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and follows Amplitude's hybrid work model. Regular in-office collaboration is an important part of the role, enabling close partnership with the Head of Marketing and cross-functional teams while maintaining flexibility where appropriate.

s.h: As an Executive Assistant, you will
s.t:
Protect executive time and create leverage: Proactively manage complex calendars, travel, meeting preparation, communications, decisions, and follow-ups, ensuring the Head of Marketing can focus on the highest-impact priorities.
Turn ideas into action: Help transform early-stage ideas and rough concepts into clear next steps, briefs, pilots, owners, and timelines. Jumpstart projects by clarifying roles, coordinating stakeholders, establishing tracking, and bringing a first version to life before handing execution off to the appropriate team.
Keep priorities moving: Create visibility across key priorities and initiatives, track follow-ups and decisions, surface blockers, and ensure important work doesn't stall or fall through the cracks.
Use AI to improve how we work: Run and co-manage AI-powered workflows and systems that improve productivity, team cohesion, communication, and effectiveness. Monitor quality, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve workflows over time.
Support high-impact marketing initiatives: Help coordinate leadership meetings, offsites, QBRs, team experiences, customer initiatives, and external events—including emerging AI-focused marketing events and programs.

s.h: You'll be a great addition to the team if
s.t:
You are highly proactive and bring a high-agency mindset to your work. You don't wait for perfect instructions and are comfortable taking the first step to move something forward.
You are operationally strong and process-oriented , while understanding that process should simplify work rather than create unnecessary bureaucracy.
You are an AI-fluent practitioner who actively uses AI tools to improve your own productivity and the effectiveness of the teams you support.
You are an excellent simplifier who can move seamlessly between small details and ambiguous, cross-functional problems while keeping the bigger picture in view.
You build trust quickly and communicate effectively with executives, cross-functional partners, and external stakeholders, while exercising exceptional judgment and discretion.

s.h: At a minimum, you need to have
s.t:
5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting VP- or C-level executives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Experience managing complex executive calendars, domestic and international travel, meeting logistics, expenses, and executive communications.
Demonstrated experience coordinating projects, events, or cross-functional initiatives and driving follow-through across multiple stakeholders.
Strong proficiency with Google Workspace and experience using AI tools or automation to improve workflows, productivity, or decision-making.
A track record of handling highly confidential information with professionalism, integrity, sound judgment, and discretion.
The ability to work from our San Francisco office as part of our hybrid work model.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

A propos de Bull
Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA.
Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques.
Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique.
Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients.

Contexte
Chez BULL, nous concevons et déployons des systèmes informatiques à haute performance, d'intelligence artificielle et des technologies critiques au service des infrastructures stratégiques. En tant que leader européen indépendant, BULL se positionne à la pointe de l'innovation et de l'excellence industrielle.
Dans le cadre du remplacement d'un départ en retraite au sein de la R&D, le poste est maintenu et rattaché à la Business Unit ECN. Il s'inscrit dans un périmètre transversal et mutualisé entre nos activités ECN et nos équipes R&D.
En tant qu' Executive Assistant , vous intervenez au cœur du leadership exécutif. Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous apportez un support organisationnel et opérationnel de haut niveau visant à garantir l'alignement stratégique, la fluidité des opérations et l'efficacité de la prise de décision.
Responsabilités principales
Vos Missions S'articulent Autour De La Gestion Des Priorités Exécutives, Du Suivi De La Gouvernance Et De La Performance Opérationnelle
Pilotage de l'agenda et organisation exécutive
Orchestrer, optimiser et arbitrer l'agenda ainsi que le rythme exécutif de la direction dans un environnement complexe et très réactif.
Planifier et coordonner les instances de gouvernance, réunions de direction et événements exécutifs.
Organiser les déplacements complexes (nationaux et internationaux).
Préparation des livrables et suivi des décisions
Préparer et consolider les supports stratégiques (dossiers, notes de cadrage, présentations de niveau direction, synthèses).
Assurer le suivi rigoureux ( follow-up ) des décisions clés, des plans d'action et des initiatives de transformation.
Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et dashboards de la direction.
Communication, synthèse et interface stratégique
Rédiger des communications et comptes-rendus à fort niveau d'exigence et de synthèse.
Assurer l'interface privilégiée et fluide entre la direction, les lignes d'affaires ECN, la R&D et les parties prenantes externes de haut niveau.
Traiter la correspondance, le filtrage des sollicitations et garantir la stricte confidentialité des dossiers confiés.

Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions de support exécutif (Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner) ou de gestion d'entreprise auprès de dirigeants. Expérience confirmée au sein d'organisations internationales , matricielles et à fort rythme.
Requis
Solide culture d'entreprise et compréhension fine des enjeux et priorités stratégiques d'une direction générale.
Excellente maîtrise de la suite Microsoft 365 et des outils de collaboration exécutive.
Capacités rédactionnelles, de communication et d'esprit de synthèse de haut niveau.
Bilinguisme parfait en Français et Anglais (usage quotidien à l'oral comme à l'écrit avec des interlocuteurs internationaux).
Optionnel
Expérience préalable au sein d'un environnement R&D, hautement technologique ou industriel.
Expérience réussie sur un poste en support partagé/transversal entre plusieurs entités ou Business Units.
Soft Skills
Posture de partenaire de confiance, sens élevé de la responsabilité et présence exécutive.
Forte capacité d'anticipation, de priorisation et d'autonomie dans la gestion de l'ambiguïté.
Rigueur, diplomatie, aisance relationnelle et discrétion absolue.
Pourquoi postuler ?
Ce poste offre une exposition directe aux prises de décision stratégiques au sein d'un leader européen de la technologie. Vous jouerez un rôle de bras droit exécutif à fort impact sur la performance opérationnelle des entités ECN et R&D, au sein d'un environnement stimulant.
Pourquoi ne pas postuler ?
Si vous recherchez un poste d'assistanat classique sans exposition aux enjeux stratégiques et sans proximité directe avec un niveau de direction générale (EVP).
Si vous privilégiez un environnement de travail strictement local et n'avez pas l'habitude des contextes internationaux bilingues.
Si vous n'avez pas encore l'autonomie nécessaire pour piloter en toute indépendance des dossiers transversaux complexes et arbitrer des priorités mouvantes.

This is Proton’s first Executive Assistant hire. You will work directly with the CEO, keeping his schedule, logistics, and day-to-day running smoothly so he can focus on what matters most. The role starts at a minimum of 50% and is designed to grow: as trust builds, so will your responsibilities.
We are looking for someone at the start of their career, or someone who values flexibility and wants to build something from scratch alongside a fast-moving executive team. What matters most is not years of experience. It is reliability, discretion, good judgment, and a genuine willingness to do whatever it takes, for this role, no task is too small.

Manage the CEO’s calendar: schedule and reschedule meetings, protect focused work time, and make sure the right things happen at the right time.
Know the CEO’s schedule well enough to coordinate on his behalf — which days he doesn’t take meetings, when he’s traveling, what’s happening before or after a commitment so time doesn’t get booked incorrectly.
Book meetings and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders directly, representing the CEO’s preferences clearly and professionally.
Coordinate executive team meetings, management reviews, and board meetings, including logistics and follow-up.
Handle travel planning end-to-end: flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries, and any changes along the way.
Take care of personal tasks and errands as needed — this is a role where no task is beneath you and being helpful is the job.
Support ad hoc projects as they come up, with minimal direction and good follow-through.

Reliable above all else: when you say you’ll do something, it gets done. No reminders needed.
Discreet: you will be close to sensitive information, and you treat that with the seriousness it deserves.
A quick learner: you pick things up fast, ask good questions, and don’t make the same mistake twice.
Calm and organized under pressure: when plans change — and they will — you adapt without drama.
A clear communicator in English, written and verbal; additional languages (especially German or French) are a real plus.
Genuinely helpful by nature: you think in terms of what needs to get done.

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here )
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. Admin. You manage expenses and finance admin and can support with occasional personal assistant (PA) duties as needed.
CEO office collaboration. You’ll work in very close coordination with the CEO office, which includes a Chief of Staff and CEO Office Manager who are responsible for operational processes in the CEO office. Incl. performance management, KPI tracking, leadership accountability and strategic projects.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have previously supported a CEO or equivalent in a demanding organisation and are looking for another environment that gives you an opportunity to grow.
You want to be in a young, fast company. You are comfortable with ambiguity, short timelines and a team that is still writing its own playbook, and you would rather shape the system than inherit a finished one.
You are mission-driven. You care that European companies build and adopt AI, and you want your work to count toward that rather than toward a job title. You are eager to automate your own work where possible.
AI can do a lot of things, but in the short term, it won't be able to shepherd a growing group of mostly young people in a very dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who can foster the most important human qualities within the organization.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not someone optimizing for their next role.
Personified calmness – You bring order, not chaos. When things get hectic, you're the person who slows down, thinks clearly, and helps others do the same. Your presence makes people feel like things are under control. You instill calmness and continuity in the organization.

Compassionate and empathetic – You care about the people around you. You understand that behind every missed deadline or dropped ball is a human with hidden context. You hold people accountable with kindness.
Ownership mentality – You see problems and fix them without being asked. You don't wait for permission. You follow through.
Strong communicator – Written and verbal. You can draft important emails or have a difficult conversation with equal skill.
Trustworthy – You'll have access to everything and work directly with the CEO. Discretion and trust are very important.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.
Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.
The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Auf unserer Webseite zur Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert - wir arbeiten konsequent an einer klimaneutralen Zukunft.
## Neugierig? Sind wir auch. ##
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:
* Bewerbungsschreiben
* Lebenslauf
* Zeugnisse

Weitere Informationen über das Institut für Maschinelles Lernen finden Sie auf unserer Webseite, die Webseite der Gruppe von Professor Sachan finden Sie hier. Für Auskünfte steht Ihnen Frau Patrizia Napoli (Tel. 044 633 85 56 / E-Mail patrizia.napoli@inf.ethz.ch - keine Bewerbungsunterlagen) gerne zur Verfügung.
Gerne weisen wir darauf hin, dass die Vorselektion durch die verantwortlichen Rekrutierenden und nicht durch künstliche Intelligenz durchgeführt wird.
Für Personalvermittlungen gelten die AGB der ETH Zürich.
## Über die ETH Zürich ##
Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt.

Wir sind bekannt für unsere exzellente Lehre, wegweisende Grundlagenforschung und den direkten Transfer von neuen Erkenntnissen in die Gesellschaft. Über 30'000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden bei uns ein Umfeld, das eigenständiges Denken fördert, und ein Klima, das zu Spitzenleistungen inspiriert.

Im Herzen Europas und weltweit vernetzt entwickeln wir gemeinsam Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen.

Du kennst die neuesten Markttrends, insbesondere im Bereich Beauty-Tech.

Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für die Verkaufsstelle und koordinierst mit dem Retail- und Trainings-Team die umzusetzenden Massnahmen, um den Umsatz weiter zu steigern. Du trägst mit gezielten Aktionen und CRM zur erweiternden Pflege der Kundendatenbank bei.

Du pflegst eine Omnichannel-Service-Einstellung, die eine konstante Servicequalität sowohl offline als auch online gewährleistet.

s.t:
Du begeisterst dich für die Welt der Schönheit? Du bringst gerne die Schönheit von anderen zum Ausdruck?
Dann würden wir gerne von dir hören! Werde Ambassador für das renommierte Markenportfolio von L'Oréal Luxe, den führenden Marken im Schönheitsmarkt. Kosmetik, Pflege und Parfüms mit Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent, Giorgio Armani und unseren Luxus-Designerparfüms.
Wir bieten spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten: Erweitere deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft in einem luxuriösen Umfeld und entdecke verschiedene Werdegänge bei L-Oréal. Im Rahmen dieser Möglichkeiten kannst du verschiedene Rollen übernehmen, z. B. Make up Expert, Skin Care Coach, Store Manager, Brand Sell Out Coach und viele mehr. Erhalte Zugang zu exklusiven Giorgio Armani Beauty-Schulungsprogrammen und zu den zahlreichen Lernmöglichkeiten von L-Oréal.

L-Oréal ist auf 150 Märkten und fünf Kontinenten vertreten und widmet sich seit über einem Jahrhundert der Aufgabe, «Schönheit zu kreieren, die die Welt inspiriert und bewegt». Mit einem Gesamtumsatz von 42 Milliarden Euro ist der Konzern heute weltweit führend in der Kosmetikbranche. Gemeinsam meistern wir umfassende, komplexe Herausforderungen und wollen die Welt dabei inklusiver und nachhaltiger machen - für alle Menschen und für unseren Planeten.
L-Oréal Luxe, der weltweit führende Anbieter von luxuriöser Schönheitspflege und hochwertigen Parfüms, beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 35.000 Schönheitsexpert\*innen. Unsere Mission ist die Kreation der besten Luxus-Schönheitsprodukte und -erlebnisse in den Bereichen Parfümerie, Hautpflege und Make-up. Mit seinem Portfolio aus 25 hochwertigen und sich ergänzenden Marken bringt L-Oréal Luxe seine einzigartige Vision von luxuriöser Schönheit zum Ausdruck: La Culture de l-Écart.

Der einzige dreisprachige Kanton der Schweiz ist wirtschaftlich, kulturell und politisch vielfältig. Graubünden ist mit 7106 km² der grösste Kanton der Schweiz und bietet mit 150 Tälern, 615 Seen, 140 Ferienorten und unzähligen Sonnentagen pro Jahr eine hohe Lebensqualität. Die Kantonale Verwaltung Graubünden ist genauso vielseitig wie unsere Landschaft. Bringen Sie Ihre einzigartigen Fähigkeiten ein und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Kantonalen Verwaltung Graubünden.
Das Amt für Natur und Umwelt setzt die Bundesgesetze zum Gewässer\-, Umwelt\- sowie Natur\- und Landschaftsschutz um. Zu unseren Aufgaben gehören die Prüfung von Vorhaben auf die Einhaltung des Umweltrechts, Kontrollen von Anlagen, die Vergabe von Beiträgen, die Ausstellung von Bewilligungen sowie die Umweltbeobachtung und Umweltbildung. Zudem koordinieren wir die Umsetzung der Klima\- und Biodiversitätsstrategie.
Im Amt für Natur und Umwelt arbeiten rund 60 Fachspezialistinnen und Fachspezialisten. Das Sekretariatsteam besteht aus vier Personen und ist für die Administration des ganzen Amts zuständig.
Wir suchen für das Amt für Natur und Umwelt per 1\. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Leiterin oder einen Leiter für das Sekretariat
Dein Aufgabenbereich
Du leitest das Sekretariat und sorgst für einen effizienten und reibungslosen Ablauf des Tagesgeschäfts.
Du koordinierst die Arbeitsverteilung im Team, priorisierst Aufgaben und stellst die Einhaltung der definierten Prozesse sicher.
Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für das Sekretariatsteam sowie für die Mitarbeitenden des Amts bei Fragen und Aufträgen rund um das Sekretariat.
Du entwickelst die Abläufe im Sekretariat weiter, dokumentierst Prozesse und sorgst für deren laufende Optimierung.
Du übernimmst vielseitige administrative Aufgaben wie Telefon\- und Postdienst, die Bewirtschaftung des zentralen Postfachs sowie die Registrierung von Unterlagen in der Geschäftsverwaltung.

Altenrhein Aviation / Egli Paint (Aviation Plaza Altenrhein)
Un concept mis à l-épreuve
Aviation Plaza Altenrhein repose sur une promesse simple : trois spécialistes indépendants - Altenrhein Aviation pour la maintenance, AeroVisto pour la cabine, Egli Paint pour l-extérieur - travaillant dans un même aéroport, selon un même calendrier, durant un seul temps d-immobilisation. Pas une fusion ; un partenariat rodé à l-aéroport de St. Gallen-Altenrhein.
Le client qui a mis cette promesse à l-épreuve connaissait bien le lieu. Son Phenom 300 venait chez Altenrhein Aviation pour sa maintenance programmée année après année - une relation que le propriétaire décrit simplement : « Nous sommes comme une famille. » Lors de ces visites, AeroVisto intervenait régulièrement sur la cabine - accoudoirs, parties en bois, sièges - et son équipe visitait les ateliers pendant que d-autres rénovations prenaient forme.
Puis est venue l-inspection des 120 mois, l-événement le plus complet du calendrier de maintenance de l-avion. Le propriétaire a contacté Natascha Rode, directrice générale de AAL AG & Egli Paint GmbH, avec une décision qui a transformé un événement de maintenance en quelque chose de plus grand : profiter de l-immobilisation pour une rénovation complète - maintenance, cabine et extérieur, le tout en même temps.
Il est difficile de concevoir un projet plus dense sur un jet léger. Chaque métier réuni par l-Aviation Plaza, sur un même avion, selon un même calendrier - c-est précisément la complexité pour laquelle le concept a été conçu.
La partie maintenance
Chez Altenrhein Aviation, l-inspection des 120 mois a pénétré profondément dans la cellule, jusqu-à la révision du train d-atterrissage - selon les mots du propriétaire : « Ils doivent tout démonter. C-est vraiment quelque chose de majeur. » La préparation était à la hauteur.

L-inspection avait été planifiée avec le client environ un an à l-avance, et tout au long de la maintenance, une réunion hebdomadaire réunissait Altenrhein Aviation, l-équipe du client et Embraer autour d-une même table - les problèmes discutés tôt, les décisions prises rapidement.
« Ce n-est pas un travail facile - c-est un projet très, très difficile », déclare le propriétaire à propos de l-étendue de la maintenance. Sa conclusion : « Je suis très satisfait de ce qu-ils ont fait. »
La partie intérieure
Pour AeroVisto, le projet a commencé là où toute rénovation devrait débuter : par une inspection d-entrée documentée. Cela a changé le plan.

Le placage en bois, en service depuis plus d-une décennie, avait dépassé le stade où un simple revernissage était une option - ainsi, la menuiserie de la cabine a été replaquée puis montée jusqu-à une finition brillante brun foncé profonde qui reflète désormais la cabine autour.

Les parties plaquées racontaient une histoire similaire et ont été replaquées intégralement.
La nouvelle cabine paraît lumineuse, calme et précise. Six sièges 16G sont recouverts de cuir beige clair, avec une couture en losange qui donne à la cabine son détail signature ; le divan suit en cuir assorti.

Au plafond et le long des fenêtres, la garniture de plafond, les habillages de fenêtres et les lambrequins sont en ultracuir doux et clair qui laisse la lumière du jour faire son travail. Au sol, une moquette tuftée à la machine de ton tabac ancre la palette ; les monuments sombres et brillants l-encadrent.

Même les transitions sont soignées - nouvelles ceintures de sécurité en beige assorti, y compris les ceintures à airbag, les compartiments à bagages doublés, les escaliers d-embarquement finis avec un nouveau revêtement non textile, et le cockpit délibérément conservé dans son caractère existant avec un nouveau cuir gris moyen et une peau de mouton gris argenté.
Les décisions de design ont été prises sur place - lors des visites du client à Altenrhein, accueillies comme l-Aviation Plaza sait le faire : matériaux sur la table, ateliers à quelques pas, et Natascha Rode veillant à ce que chaque visite se déroule aussi bien que le projet lui-même.

Que le design final soit encore affiné alors que la production était déjà en cours n-a jamais posé problème - à un même endroit, les approbations, échantillons et travaux avançaient de concert.

Derrière tout cela, la voie de la certification : tests de combustion, données d-ingénierie approuvées, ordre d-ingénierie et formulaire 1 - la paperasse nécessaire avant qu-une cabine puisse être belle.
La partie peinture
Dans l-atelier de peinture moderne d-Egli Paint sur le site de l-Aviation Plaza, l-avion a reçu une finition extérieure complète - masqué, poncé et refini avec un brillant profond et uniforme. Et pendant que l-extérieur prenait forme, les travaux de maintenance et de cabine continuaient en parallèle, à quelques pas sur le même site.
Ce que change un même lieu
Un projet avec autant de métiers a un ennemi naturel : la distance. Le propriétaire, qui gère des projets aéronautiques depuis des années, le formule précisément : « Il faut finir A avant de passer à B. Si quelque chose doit être expédié de loin, cela peut retarder d-autres travaux. Quand la plupart des entreprises de soutien pour un projet comme celui-ci sont juste au coin de la rue, cela aide beaucoup. »
À Altenrhein, « au coin de la rue » est à prendre au sens littéral. Lors d-une visite, le propriétaire est passé chez AeroVisto et Egli Paint - à côté, selon ses mots. Les constats étaient discutés à l-avion, pas par chaînes d-e-mails. Et à travers tout cela, un niveau de soin personnel que le propriétaire résume en une phrase à propos de Natascha Rode : « Si vous appelez Natascha la nuit, elle est là pour vous. »
AeroVisto sert des clients dans le monde entier, et la distance n-a jamais été un obstacle : des solutions logistiques dédiées - démontage, emballage et transport gérés par les équipes d-AeroVisto - maintiennent même les projets complexes simples, où que soit basé l-avion. Et pourtant, l-Aviation Plaza ajoute quelque chose de spécial : chaque spécialiste, chaque décision, et le client lui-même - en un seul lieu.
La confirmation
Le projet s-est clôturé en personne : un contrôle qualité client sur place, puis le remontage final et la redélivrance - maintenance achevée, extérieur refini, cabine renouvelée du cockpit au compartiment à bagages. Un avion que le propriétaire appelle désormais, selon ses propres mots, « élégant et beau. »
Son verdict sur l-ensemble : « Après 120 mois, c-est plus ou moins comme si nous recevions un avion tout neuf. »
Et debout dans la cabine, il est allé plus loin dans le passé. Il avait déjà récupéré cet avion une fois - au Brésil, en 2015, à la livraison : « Regardez ce beau matériau. C-était exactement pareil quand je suis allé au Brésil pour recevoir cet avion - exactement comme ça. Tout neuf. »
Un propriétaire qui compare un avion à sa onzième année au jour où il l-a reçu - c-est le résultat que trois spécialistes se sont engagés à livrer, et la confirmation que le concept Aviation Plaza tient ses promesses.

Vous souhaitez contribuer à l-évolution du système d-information de l-Administration Cantonale Vaudoise ? Vous aimez coordonner des activités complexes, collaborer avec de multiples parties prenantes et accompagner les équipes dans l'amélioration continue des processus ?

## À propos du Département des Affaires étrangères et du Commerce ##
Le rôle du Département des Affaires étrangères et du Commerce (DFAT) est de promouvoir les intérêts de l'Australie et des Australiens à l'international.

Cela implique de renforcer la sécurité de l'Australie, d'améliorer sa prospérité, de fournir un programme d'aide étrangère efficace et de haute qualité, et d'aider les voyageurs australiens ainsi que les Australiens à l'étranger. Le département fournit des conseils en politique étrangère, commerciale et de développement au gouvernement australien.

Le DFAT collabore également avec d'autres agences gouvernementales australiennes pour coordonner la poursuite des intérêts globaux, régionaux et bilatéraux de l'Australie.
## À propos du poste ##
Sous la direction, l'Assistant Exécutif de l'Ambassadeur et du Vice-Ambassadeur fournit un soutien exécutif, administratif et organisationnel de haut niveau à la Mission Permanente d'Australie auprès des Nations Unies à Genève. Le poste organise également des événements et fonctions officiels.
En raison de la nature sensible du travail, ce poste nécessite de pouvoir obtenir et maintenir une habilitation de sécurité nationale reconnue par le DFAT.
## Les principales responsabilités du poste incluent, sans s'y limiter : ##
* Fournir un soutien exécutif de haut niveau à l'Ambassadeur et au Vice-Ambassadeur, assurant le bon fonctionnement des bureaux exécutifs dans un environnement rapide et sensible.
* Gérer et prioriser la correspondance, les invitations, les documents d'information et les demandes, en faisant preuve d'un jugement avisé pour déterminer les priorités, les actions et les exigences de conformité.
* Coordonner les visites officielles et les programmes de délégation pour les ministres, hauts fonctionnaires et visiteurs de haut niveau, en équilibrant les priorités concurrentes et les exigences opérationnelles.
* Planifier et organiser des événements de représentation, des réunions et des engagements officiels, en liaison avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pour atteindre les objectifs de la Mission.
* Gérer les dépenses de représentation et l'administration financière, y compris les prévisions, les justifications, les rapprochements et les rapports conformément aux politiques et procédures du DFAT.
* Coordonner les déplacements, la logistique et les arrangements administratifs liés aux activités de la direction exécutive et officielles, en assurant la conformité aux politiques et procédures pertinentes.
* Surveiller les risques liés à la sécurité, aux opérations et au flux de travail, en mettant en œuvre les contrôles nécessaires et en escaladant les problèmes le cas échéant.
* Fournir des conseils administratifs, maintenir des systèmes d'affaires efficaces et soutenir la coordination de l'équipe, contribuant à l'amélioration continue et à l'efficacité organisationnelle.
## Qualifications/Expérience/Connaissances/Compétences requises ##
* Expérience avérée dans un rôle similaire d'Assistant Exécutif
* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale
* Capacité à travailler en équipe et à soutenir celle-ci. Capacité à développer et maintenir des relations respectueuses et efficaces avec les parties prenantes internes et externes
* Capacité à gérer le temps, à prioriser, planifier, gérer plusieurs tâches et travailler efficacement sous pression
* Compétences en gestion financière et organisationnelle
* Discrétion et jugement avisé dans la gestion d'informations confidentielles
* Expérience étendue de l'utilisation de Microsoft Office et des applications électroniques
* Compétences exceptionnelles en service client et en relations interpersonnelles
* Maîtrise de l'anglais requise, la maîtrise du français étant fortement appréciée
* Connaissance ou capacité à acquérir rapidement une connaissance de la législation du gouvernement australien ou des politiques et directives départementales relatives aux fonctions du poste
## Souhaitable ##
* Expérience préalable dans une ambassade, une organisation internationale ou un environnement comparable.
## Exigences de sécurité ##
* Habilitation de sécurité NV2 australienne ou capacité à l'obtenir et la maintenir. Les candidats doivent donc être citoyens australiens pour être considérés.
* Veuillez noter que les candidats détenant la citoyenneté ou la double citoyenneté suisse ne sont pas éligibles à une habilitation de sécurité australienne.

En tant que **Coordinateur·trice de programme**, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la planification, l'organisation et la coordination des programmes et événements de la Fondation.

Vous assurerez le suivi des différentes étapes des projets, de leur préparation à leur évaluation, en collaboration avec les équipes internes, les bénévoles, les intervenants et les partenaires.

Vous veillerez à la bonne coordination des aspects logistiques, administratifs et organisationnels, tout en garantissant une communication fluide entre les différentes parties prenantes. ### Missions et responsabilités ###
**Planification et coordination des événements :**
* Participer à l-élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de la planification, des calendriers et des budgets des événements.
* Collaborer avec les équipes internes, notamment celles chargées de la communication et de l-accueil, afin d-harmoniser les objectifs et le contenu des événements.

* Superviser la mise en place, les inscriptions et la gestion des problèmes afin d-assurer un bon déroulement.

**Shape how Tax & Legal professionals use AI in their everyday work.**
As AI becomes an essential part of professional services, our Tax & Legal teams have an exciting opportunity to enhance the way we work, collaborate and deliver value to clients. In this role, you will help translate this opportunity into practical adoption by making AI tools accessible, relevant and easy to use for our people.
Working closely with Tax & Legal teams, AI specialists and colleagues across geographies and service lines, you will drive the AI adoption plan, build a strong community of champions and help teams turn ideas into concrete use cases, prompts, templates and automations.
**How you can make an impact**
* Get a detailed understanding of and work with the AI assets our firm has available, and which are used in Tax & Legal, globally, regionally and locally in Switzerland, and get a detailed understanding of the use(d) cases available.
* Be responsible for the increase of the adoption and effective use of AI tools across Tax & Legal by shaping and driving a clear, practical adoption plan
* Design and deliver engaging learning formats, including general and team-specific trainings, self-paced materials, drop-in sessions, and 1-on-1 support
* Identify, test and communicate relevant AI use cases, prompts, templates and automations that help teams work more effectively and create value for clients
* Build and nurture a Tax & Legal AI Community, enabling champions to share experiences, spread knowledge and connect teams across Switzerland and other geographies
* Measure usage and adoption, gather feedback and proactively define actions to improve engagement, confidence and impact over time

* You are curious, well-organised and people-oriented, with a talent for making new technologies understandable, practical and motivating for different audiences
* You have a university degree or equivalent qualification in business, law, tax, technology, innovation management, change management or a related field
* You bring experience in project coordination, change management, learning enablement, digital transformation or technology adoption, ideally in a professional services environment
* You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools and enjoy translating use cases into clear guidance, prompts, templates or simple automations together with specialists
* You communicate confidently in English; German or French is an advantage for collaboration with teams across Switzerland
**Your Team**
You will join a collaborative Tax & Legal environment in Switzerland where innovation, knowledge sharing and practical client impact go hand in hand. The role connects closely with professionals across our teams, AI experts in other service lines and geographies, and a growing network of AI champions. Together, you will create an open community where ideas, use cases and experiences are shared, questions are welcomed, and teams are supported in applying AI confidently in their day-to-day work.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.
In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors.
