## **Job Description** ##
At Takeda, the Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization is driving our digital strategy and evolution by transforming our capabilities, structures and processes to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet.
Zurich is one of Takeda-s key global hubs and an important location for our DD&T organization. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey, where you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and become part of an innovative organization contributing to global impact and improvement.
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and the abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our colleagues- journey at Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.

This is a dual-mandate role within Takeda-s Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Reporting into the Enterprise Process Platforms organization, the successful candidate will serve in two complementary capacities:
* **Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms -** providing dedicated, high-quality executive administrative support to the leader of the organization, with full administrative accountability for that leader.
* **DD&T Site Lead for Zurich -** serving as the local DD&T Leadership Team (LT) site support resource when DD&T LT members travel to Zurich, ensuring a consistent, professional, and executive-ready onsite experience.
The Zurich Site Lead responsibility focuses on site-specific logistics and local coordination for DD&T LT activity in Zurich; it does not include assuming administrative ownership for other LT members. This role is based in Zurich.

Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms
Provide dedicated executive administrative support to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms, operating with the discretion, judgment, and executive presence required to support a senior DD&T leader and to interact effectively with Takeda Executive Team (TET) members.
* **Calendar and schedule management:** Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar - prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.
* **Meeting coordination and agenda preparation:** Coordinate meetings end-to-end, prepare and circulate agendas, coordinate pre-reads, and ensure the leader is fully prepared.
* **Meeting facilitation:** Where appropriate, facilitate or lead meetings on behalf of the leader.
* **Executive communications:** Draft, review, and coordinate executive-level communications, and communicate clearly and professionally with TET members, senior leaders, and their assistants on behalf of the leader.
* **Stakeholder management:** Build and maintain strong working relationships across DD&T, the broader enterprise, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for the leader-s office.
* **Travel and event logistics:** Organize complex domestic and international travel and associated logistics - including multi-party alignment across internal groups and, at times, external or industry partners - and partner with central meeting planning teams on larger trips, meetings, and events.
* **Expenses coordination:** Work with DD&T central expense management role to ensure appropriate submission and completion of leader expenses
* **Documents, presentations, and data:** Where appropriate, prepare and coordinate documents, correspondence, reports, and presentations; collect, review, enter, and format accurate data using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; and ensure materials adhere to corporate and organizational standards.
* **Vendor and payment support:** Prepare documentation for payment of vendors, consultants, and suppliers; submit and track payment requests and purchase orders and respond to related inquiries.
* **Confidentiality, judgment and discretion:** Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion at all times and exercise strong, independent judgment - including the confidence to respectfully challenge or decline a request from a senior leader or TET member when it is in the best interest of the leader-s priorities.
* **Proactivity and problem solving:** Anticipate the leader-s needs, identify issues early, and resolve problems proactively before they escalate.
* **Continuous improvement and network:** Participate in process improvement and build a strong internal network to answer questions, solve problems, and execute responsibilities effectively.
* **Junior and team administrative support:** Provide guidance and support to junior administrative staff, enhancing team capabilities, and aid the broader administrative team as needed to ensure seamless DD&T senior leader support

s.t:
DD&T Zurich Site Lead (Local Hub Support)
Serve as the local DD&T site support resource and point of contact when DD&T Leadership Team (LT) members travel to Zurich. This responsibility is focused on site-specific logistics and local coordination - creating a consistent, high-quality experience for visiting DD&T LT members.
A. Site Logistics and Meeting Room Coordination
* Identify and book appropriate rooms for DD&T LT meetings based on attendee size, confidentiality, meeting type, executive experience, and technology requirements.
* Confirm room suitability - seating capacity, executive readiness, configuration, hybrid meeting capability, and proximity to relevant office areas.
* Coordinate with local workplace, facilities, reception, security, ETSS, CTSS, and AV teams as needed.
* Support onsite readiness before meetings begin - room access, setup, supplies, and escalation of facilities or technology issues.
* Serve as the local point of contact for site-specific logistical questions related to DD&T LT visits.
B. Catering and Hospitality Support
* Arrange catering for DD&T LT meetings, including working lunches, refreshments, and coffee service.
* Confirm dietary requirements, timing, delivery location, setup, and cleanup expectations.
* Coordinate with approved onsite catering providers and local site teams.
* Ensure catering plans align with the agenda, meeting flow, and executive-level expectations.
* Escalate issues promptly when catering, hospitality, or room readiness may impact the attendee experience.
C. Local Reservations and Offsite Needs
* Make restaurant reservations for DD&T LT dinners, small executive gatherings, and business meals connected to DD&T LT travel.
* Recommend appropriate local venues based on audience, purpose, location, accessibility, timing, and executive expectations.
* Coordinate reservation details, timing, attendee count, and dietary considerations with venues.
* Support approved offsite reservations connected to DD&T LT activities, keeping the primary scope on onsite hub support.

Exceptional communication skills — you write, speak, and represent with polish and precision
A track record of building systems and processes that scale, not just executing tasks

s.h: The role / What are we looking for?
s.t:
KPMB is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Junior Executive Assistant professional to join our team. This administrative role is integral in ensuring that our executive team operates efficiently and effectively by providing comprehensive administrative support. You will be responsible in handling various tasks to ensure our executives can focus on their core responsibilities. The role demands a proactive, self-motivated individual who demonstrates initiative.

You will work closely with our Senior Executive Assistant to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, and ensure all administrative tasks are handled promptly and accurately. Ultimately, you will contribute to the smooth operation of our executive functions, keeping the team informed and on track with their deliverables and priorities.

Manage daily calendars for the Partners, scheduling meetings, conferences, events, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Work closely with the Executive administration team to maintain comprehensive and accurate records, including document management and filing systems.
Manage timesheets, expenses, and invoices for the Partners, including creating expense reports and submitting invoices for payment.

Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence including emails and phone calls, ensuring timely responses and follow-ups.
Assist in the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, and minutes.
Office license management (Partner’s licenses in various provinces and states, registration, licensing renewal, etc.)
Front desk coverage when Receptionist is away.

Take detailed minutes during internal and external meetings, ensuring all action items are clearly documented and distributed to relevant personnel.
Coordinate and communicate with various departments, stakeholders, and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.

Update meeting agendas and take detailed minutes for Business Development and Marketing meetings.
Schedule content development meetings, calls, and calendar coordination for team members and external collaborators.
Ensure corporate memberships for various associations are current, including registrations and renewals.
Administrative coordination for sponsorships and marketing activations: digital filing for contracts, reports, invoices, etc.
Handle conference and event registration and RSVPs for Leadership.
Manage travel arrangements for conferences, meetings, and events for partners and team members.
Lead coordination of marketing events, including liaising with third-party vendors.
Assist in preparation and distribution for marketing collateral (technical prep, mailings).
Coordinate logistics for internal and external meeting (venue booking, catering, AV, guest lists).
Serve as point of contact between Marketing/Business Development team and other business functions.
Maintain CRM database to ensure up-to-date, accurate, and legible experience.
Pull reports from marketing software.

A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar administrative or assistant role.
Ability to multitask, managing a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
Outstanding organizational, schedule coordination, and administrative skills.
Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Praised to have problem solving and critical thinking skills.
A self-starter who demonstrates initiative.

Founded in 1987, KPMB Architects has developed a diverse portfolio of architectural projects that focus on building healthy, vibrant cities and communities. The firm has grown to include over 100 employees and is recognized for its highly collaborative and supportive culture, as well as its wide variety of experience and educational backgrounds.

Some of our team members have grown with the firm from the start of their careers to become leaders, while others have joined at various points in their careers, bringing new ideas and approaches.

We provide a learning environment where teaching, mentoring, and collaboration are integral parts of our DNA. At KPMB, there are numerous opportunities to share your skills, engage in firm activities beyond project work, and contribute to our initiatives that give back to the community.

KPMB is committed to fostering a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we operate in and serve. KPMB Architects is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants regardless of age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected status.

A daily free shuttle bus between Union Station and KPMB’s office is provided for all staff who use the subway system or GO transit, from Monday to Thursday. Underground bicycle parking is also available.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to support application screening. All applications are ultimately reviewed and assessed by qualified members of our recruitment team.

Executive Assistant - Chicago

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support our partnership team. The ideal candidate will be resourceful, detail-oriented, mission focused, and capable of handling a wide range of administrative and executive support tasks.

The chosen candidate will have at least six years of full-time, onsite experience in a professional office setting with a proven record of success in all areas required of the role. This position is a member of the Administrative Team, which includes HR, Operations, and Office Managers. The position reports to the Director of HR but works directly for the partner.

This position is full-time and based onsite in our Chicago office in the West Loop area. Benefits can be found listed on our careers page.

These responsibilities reflect the dynamic role of an Executive Assistant, where flexibility, organization, and proactive support are essential to the business's success and efficiency.

Administrative Support

Manage partners' calendars and schedules, including arranging appointments and meetings.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, including emails, letters, and calls.
Prepare reports and presentations for meetings and presentations.
Support partners with quarterly goals and other small projects as requested.
Ensure completion of all tasks with high focus on prompt follow-through.
Anticipate partners' needs and proactively handle administrative tasks.
Conduct research and compile data for executive decision-making.
Handle personal tasks and errands as requested.

Communication Liaison

Handle requests and queries appropriately.
Act as a liaison between partners, teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
Coordinate client meetings and events, ensuring a smooth experience.
Ability to acknowledge the sensitivity and maintain privacy of internal partner and leadership coordination.
Ensure partner and leadership dialog in sensitive matters held in confidence.

Travel and Accommodation Arrangements

Arrange travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation.
Prepare travel agendas (often with input from other team members), necessary documents, and expense reports.
Share the partners’ travel agendas with other team members for coordination.
Ensure travel plans align with partners' schedules and preferences.

Data Management and Record Keeping

Maintain accurate records and files, both electronic and physical.
Ensure information confidentiality and data protection.

Share opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
Implement best practices in administrative support.
Stay updated on industry trends and administrative tools to enhance job performance.

Proven experience as an executive or administrative assistant or similar administrative role.
Excellent MS Office knowledge and proficiency and Abobe Suite, specifics experience with InDesign and PowerPoint.
Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
Ability to multitask and prioritize daily workload.
Discretion and confidentiality.
Knowledge of EOS and the supporting platform (Bloomgrowth) is a plus but not required.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Experience in a business environment.
Expertise in project management tools and software.
Experience managing and coordinating requests from multiple staff.

Work Environment: Monday through Friday 8:30-5:30 with an hour for lunch/breaks.
Benefits: Health benefits, paid time off, 401(k), to/from office commute paid, or parking provided, and opportunities for career growth within a dynamic and expanding company.

Salary: Range is $70,000-$85,000; the offer will be based on experience, skills and background in similar positions.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter outlining their qualifications and why they are interested in working with us. Please include any relevant work samples or references. Elliott Wood is a forward‑thinking and purpose-led engineering and built environment consultancy. We believe in a bigger and better idea of engineering. One driven by strategic consultancy and married with creative and technical expertise. Together we act as originators, advisors and doers for the built environment and beyond.

As a certified B Corp, our role is to continue to inspire clients and organisations to think differently about their projects and buildings — not just aesthetically and commercially — but for the benefit of the planet and people who use them every day.

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our CEO, COO and Board and play a key role in the effective operation of our Executive Office and wider leadership team.

This is a varied and highly trusted role, working closely with senior leaders across the business to manage executive priorities, coordinate Board and leadership governance, and support the delivery of wider business and strategic initiatives.

You will be proactive, highly organised and comfortable working independently, with the confidence to manage competing priorities and anticipate what is needed before being asked. You will build strong relationships across the business and externally, exercising sound judgement and discretion when handling confidential and commercially sensitive information.

Provide proactive Executive Assistant support to the CEO, COO and Board, managing priorities and helping them operate effectively

Manage complex diaries and meeting schedules, balancing competing priorities and anticipating requirements

Coordinate agendas, briefing papers, presentations and supporting documentation to ensure executives are well prepared for meetings

Lead the end-to-end coordination of Board and Executive Leadership Team meetings, including Board packs, minute taking and action tracking

Maintain governance records and ensure agreed actions are followed through to completion

Manage executive correspondence and act as a trusted point of contact for confidential and sensitive matters

Coordinate travel, meetings and logistics, working closely with our wider Administration Team

Build strong relationships with Board members, Directors, employees, clients and external stakeholders

Support the preparation of executive communications, reports and presentations

Support confidential projects, business planning and strategic initiatives across the organisation

Facilitate contracts, appointments and documentation requiring Director review or signature

Identify opportunities to improve Executive Office processes and ways of working, including the effective use of AI and digital tools

You will have significant experience working as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or in a similar role supporting at CEO, C-Suite or senior executive level.

You will be confident managing complex diaries and competing priorities, with experience supporting Board and senior leadership meetings from initial planning through to minutes and action tracking. You will be an excellent communicator, comfortable building relationships at all levels and trusted to handle sensitive information with discretion.

Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

Excellent written communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level correspondence, presentations and briefing papers

Confidence communicating with Board members, senior leaders, clients and external stakeholders

Strong judgement, attention to detail and the ability to anticipate requirements

A proactive approach to problem-solving and improving ways of working

Strong digital skills and an interest in using technology and AI to work more effectively

Experience within professional services, consultancy, engineering or construction would be beneficial, as would experience supporting multiple senior executives, strategic projects, Business Development activity or CRM systems.

This is an opportunity to work at the heart of Elliott Wood, partnering closely with our CEO, COO, Board and senior leadership team and gaining exposure to the strategic and operational priorities shaping our business.

We are looking for someone who enjoys creating clarity, bringing structure to a busy environment and building trusted relationships. You will have the opportunity to influence how our Executive Office operates, improve ways of working and support initiatives that have an impact across the wider business.

As a certified B Corp, we are committed to considering the impact our business has on our people, communities and the environment. You will contribute to this by supporting and aligning with our ESG strategy and helping us recognise and communicate the positive impact of our work.
